reports.title: Darren Goddard
categories: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths
Wales prevention of future deaths reports (2019 onwards)

promises.quote: Review and provide definite warnings (oral and written) of sepsis when consenting patients to TRUS, and upon their discharge.
promises.summary: Implement consistent sepsis warnings in TRUS consent forms and discharge communications.

promises.quote: We can confirm that a single leaflet, which is produced by the British Association of Urological Surgeons (BAUS), is now used, which states that patients should expect to go home on the same day, with no specific time scales given.
promises.summary: Adopt standardized discharge leaflet from BAUS to avoid conflicting advice.

promises.quote: Further training of Triage nursing staff and doctors of the sepsis 6 bundle and =e} Score (NEWS) documentation, escalation and the implementation of the Sepsis 6 bundle.
promises.summary: Train staff on Sepsis 6 bundle, NEWS documentation, and escalation protocols.
promises.timescale: ongoing (held on hold due to COVID-19)

promises.quote: will also ensure that point of care testing for venous blood gases is introduced in order to identify abnormal lactate results, which are key to the early identification of sepsis.
promises.summary: Introduce point-of-care testing for venous blood gases to detect lactate abnormalities for early sepsis identification.

promises.quote: The learning from your report and the University Health Board's own investigations has been shared with individual staff, and also across the organisation via the Health Board's Listening & Learning Feedback Newsletter.
promises.summary: Disseminate learning from report via staff newsletters and feedback mechanisms.

concerns.quote: TRUS elective surgery 'consenting' and information provision (oral and in written format) places a misleading emphasis on flu-like symptoms as adverse effects
concerns.hazard: misleading emphasis on flu-like symptoms as adverse effects

concerns.quote: The accuracy of the 1% risk of sepsis incidence provided
Premature discharge post-operatively from the recovery unit with the missed opportunity to recognise the adverse effect of sepsis when they occurred
The failure at triage to escalate this referral to seeing a doctor within 10 mins of admission
concerns.hazard: failure to escalate referral within 10 minutes

concerns.quote: Subsequent failure to provide timely and appropriate fluids and antibiotics
concerns.hazard: failure to provide timely fluids and antibiotics

concerns.quote: Delay in admission to Critical Care

reports.title: Clara Winter: Prevention of future deaths report
categories: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths
Wales prevention of future deaths reports (2019 onwards)

concerns.quote: significant learning was required by staff regarding timeliness of escalation and maintenance of fluid balance charts and recommended that all registered nurses from surgical wards should attend an 'Acutely Unwell' study day
concerns.hazard: delayed escalation and inadequate fluid balance monitoring

links.explanation: Both reports highlight delays in recognizing patient deterioration and escalating care promptly. The earlier report focuses on triage escalation within 10 minutes, while the later report stresses timeliness of escalation and fluid balance monitoring on surgical wards.
links.earlier_quote: (4) The failure at triage to escalate this referral to seeing a doctor within 10 mins of admission.
links.later_quote: The Health Board accepted that significant learning was required by staff regarding timeliness of escalation and maintenance of fluid balance charts
links.promise_quote: Further training of Triage nursing staff and doctors of the sepsis 6 bundle and =e} Score (NEWS) documentation, escalation and the implementation of the Sepsis 6 bundle.
